items.title: Introducing the Amazon SageMaker JumpStart Model Leaderboard
items.summary: The Amazon SageMaker JumpStart Model Leaderboard compares 70+ foundation models side by side on quality, speed, and cost, directly in SageMaker Studio. Learn what the leaderboard shows, how AWS benchmarks models, and how to go from a shortlist to a deployed model.
items.creator: Dan Ferguson
